text: The chairman opened the meeting with a short word.
translation: 主席用一句话宣布会议开始。
note: 会议的主持人 = 主席

text: Our chairman called the vote at last.
translation: 我们的主席最后宣布表决。
note: 表决由主席宣布 = 主席

text: The chairman spoke for the whole group.
note: 团体会议主持人 = 主席

text: Who will be chairman of tomorrow's meeting?
He is the chairman of the big old company.
translation: 他是那家大公司的会长。

text: The chairman of the bank spoke to the press.
translation: 银行的会长对媒体讲话。

text: Our chairman earns more than any worker.
translation: 我们会长赚得比任何员工都多。
note: 公司最高负责人 = 会长

text: She became chairman of the school board last year.
translation: 她去年成了校董会的会长。

text: The old chairman left the room for ten minutes.
translation: 老主席离开了房间十分钟。

text: The young chairman of that club speaks three languages.
translation: 那个俱乐部的年轻会长会说三种语言。
note: 俱乐部负责人 = 会长
